newsitem.title: UK: Safeway, ASDA resist tumbling FTSE 100.
newsitem.headline: Safeway, ASDA resist tumbling FTSE 100.

text.p: Leading UK supermarket chains Safeway Plc and ASDA Group Plc held their ground on Friday as other FTSE 100 stocks tumbled.
"The whole sector is doing well," said one analyst, who asked not to be named, adding that food retailers did not have the worries over sterling's strength faced by overseas earners.

Another analyst added there were hopes for the traditional buoyant Christmas trading season for the supermarket sector. By 1200 GMT, both ASDA and Safeway had hardly moved, with Safeway up 1/2p at 383p and Asda up 1/4p at 121-1/2p. In stark contrast, the FTSE index was down 55.8 points or 1.40 percent at 3934.9.
Meanwhile rivals Tesco Plc and J Sainsbury Plc were down just 1p to 345p and 3p to 352p respectively.
